title: 第12章 你手坏了？
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

时钟滴答滴答转动着，秒针转动过一圈后，正是15点00分。

熟悉的机械声音准时响起。

“下午好司陇，你的通勤车辆已到达目的地，张师傅已就位。”

“知道了。”

司陇丢下手中的眼线笔，又仔细看了一眼镜子中的自己，算了就这样吧，也化不出花了。

只见她裹着一件超长，直到脚踝的皮大衣，低着头戴着墨镜从别墅中出来。

看见她出来张师傅立马下了车开好后车门，却半天没有人过来，他回头看了一眼，发现司陇竟然跌坐在地上。

“啊副主任您......”

“没事！”

司陇撑着地站了起来，拍了拍皮衣上的灰，但走路姿态仍有些别扭。

她鞋柜里的高跟鞋，鞋跟也都太高了吧，她不得不把重心都往前放才能走得稍微顺畅些。

她根本没有穿高跟鞋的经验，为了这次的行动才不得不硬搭配上这双黑色细高跟。

很快到了局里。

下午的人很多，司陇在走廊上看到不少身着制服的工作人员，大家在经过她两侧时都会向她点头微笑。

但她谁也不认识，索性戴着墨镜目不斜视，乘坐电梯直奔三楼会议室。

司陇推开会议室的门，发现里面人还不少。

冯野和一个男人正站在窗边说话，会议长桌一侧坐着两女一男，而她的助理周世通正围着会议桌挨个倒水发资料。

看到周世通今天打扮的一身，她嘴角狠狠地抽了抽。

好家伙这执行的也太到位了吧，大金链子小皮鞋，倒水的手上不停，胳膊里还夹着一个公文包。

搭配上他的大背头和啤酒肚，简直绝了。

“诶，司副主任您来了。”

周世通转头看见司陇，笑得满脸堆肉。

“您看我今天这身怎么样？”

一旁的两女一男听到周世通这么问，再看着他样子都笑了起来，其中一个笑的最大声的女孩说道。

“哈哈哈周大叔，你这套确实很配你的油腻男气质，以后多穿啊。”

周世通闻言有些不好意思地挠了挠头。

司陇扫了一眼那女孩，破天荒的，竟然给予了周世通全肯定。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The clock was ticking, and after the second hand made one revolution, it was exactly 15:00.

The familiar mechanical sound sounded on time.

"Good afternoon Silong, your commuter vehicle has arrived at its destination and Master Zhang is in place."

"Got it."

Si Long put down the eyeliner in his hand and took a closer look at himself in the mirror. Forget it, he could just leave it as it was. There was nothing he could do.

She was seen walking out of the villa wrapped in an extra-long fur coat that reached her ankles, her head lowered and wearing sunglasses.

When he saw her coming out, Master Zhang immediately got out of the car and opened the back door, but no one came for a long time. He looked back and found that Si Long had fallen to the ground.

"Ah, deputy director, you..."

"It's okay!"

Si Long stood up and patted the dust on his leather jacket, but his walking posture was still a bit awkward.

The heels of the high-heeled shoes in her shoe cabinet were probably too high. She had to put her weight forward to walk a little smoothly.

She had no experience wearing high heels at all, so she had to wear a pair of black stiletto heels for this action.

Arriving at the bureau soon.

There were a lot of people in the afternoon. Si Long saw many uniformed staff in the corridor. Everyone nodded and smiled at her when passing by her.

But she didn't know anyone, so she simply wore sunglasses and took the elevator straight to the conference room on the third floor.

Si Long opened the door of the conference room and found that there were many people inside.

Feng Ye and a man were standing by the window talking. Two women and one man were sitting on one side of the long conference table, and her assistant Zhou Shitong was pouring water and handing out information around the conference table.

Seeing how Zhou Shitong was dressed today, the corners of her mouth twitched fiercely.

The good guy did this very well, with a big gold chain, small leather shoes, his hand pouring water constantly, and a briefcase in his arm.

Paired with his big slicked back hair and beer belly, it's simply stunning.

"Hey, Deputy Director Si, you are here."

Zhou Shitong turned around and saw Si Long with a smile on his face.

"What do you think of my appearance today?"

The two women and one man on the side all laughed when they heard Zhou Shitong ask this question, and one of the girls who laughed the loudest said.

"Hahaha Uncle Zhou, this suit of yours really matches your greasy masculinity. Wear it more often in the future."

Zhou Shitong scratched his head in embarrassment upon hearing this.

Si Long glanced at the girl, and for the first time, he gave Zhou Shitong full approval.
